Backup kaise lein?: How do I take a backup?
Backup page par \"Backup download\" daba: On the Backup page press "Backup download". All data comes in one file. Keep this file safe in Google Drive or email. Only the owner can do this.
Bill par customer chun kar poora ya kuch: Choose a customer on the bill and put all or part of it on credit. The Credit page has every customer's account. When money comes, record a "Payment" in their account.
Bill par customer chunein: Choose a customer on the bill
Bill se return, stock khud wapas: Return from the bill, stock back by itself
Write the bill or product number.
Billing → Plans me plan aur muddat chune: In Billing → Plans choose a plan and period. A bill is made; pay by bank or wallet and upload the screenshot. The plan starts once approved. See limits in the Usage tab.
Counter par pehla bill 1 minute me: Your first bill at the counter in 1 minute
Customer kaise banayein?: How do I add a customer?
Customers page par \"Naya customer\" dab: On the Customers page press "New customer". Name is required, a phone is better. Set a credit limit if you give credit. The customer shows in POS and the credit book right away.
Din shuru karte waqt drawer me rakha cas: At the start of the day enter the cash in the drawer, at the end count it and close. Nafaa tells you how much there should be and the difference.
Discount kaise lagayein?: How do I give a discount?
Doosre lafz se search, ya seedha support: Search with other words, or ask support directly
Drawer ginna aur din ka hisaab: Counting the drawer and the day report
Excel file kaise nikaalein?: How do I get an Excel file?
Expense kaise likhein?: How do I record an expense?
Expenses page par \"Naya expense\" dabay: On the Expenses page press "New expense": amount, type (electricity, rent…) and method. It is added to profit and the day report by itself.
Exports page par period chunein aur jo f: On the Exports page choose a period and press Excel on the file you need (sales, stock, customers…). Great for sending to your accountant.
Har product par \"kam stock alert\" ki h: Set a "low stock alert" level on each product. When stock goes below it, it shows on the Low stock page and the dashboard.
Internet band ho to kya hoga?: What if the internet is down?
Kam stock ki khabar kaise milti hai?: How do I get low stock alerts?
Tell us which screen has the problem.
Kya poochna hai? Jaise: udhaar, return,: What do you want to ask? Like: credit, return, backup…
Login page par \"Password bhool gaye\" d: On the login page press "Forgot password" and open the link sent to your email. If logged in, change it from Profile → Security.
Maal wapas (return) kaise lein?: How do I take a return?
Naya maal (product) kaise daalein?: How do I add a new product?
Password ya PIN kabhi kisi ko na bhejein: Never share your password or PIN. The Nafaa team never asks for it.
Payment chunein aur bill print karein: Choose payment and print the bill
Plan kaise lein ya renew karein?: How do I get or renew a plan?
POS internet ke baghair bhi bill banata: POS makes bills without internet too. Bills stay saved on this device and go to the server as soon as the internet is back. The sales record shows "saved on computer".
POS kholein, maal scan karein ya naam se: Open POS, scan items or search by name, then press "Checkout". Choose a customer (optional), choose the payment method and finish the bill. The bill saves by itself and can also be printed.
POS par kisi cheez ke saamne ya poore bi: On POS, add a discount to an item or the whole bill — % or amount. Ready-made discount codes are made and turned off on the Discounts page.
POS par sale kaise karein?: How do I make a sale on POS?
Products page par \"Naya product\" dabay: On the Products page press "New product". Enter name, price, cost and stock, scan the barcode if there is one, then save. Photos and variants can be added later.
Purchase (purchase) darj karne se stock: Recording a purchase increases stock, a sale reduces it. Use Stock adjustments for extra, short, damaged or lost stock. Every change is written in Stock in and out.
Sale ka record kholein, bill par click k: Open the sales record, click the bill and press "Return items". Pick the items coming back and how to pay back (cash or credit). Stock is added back by itself.
Sale, cost aur expenses ek jagah: Sale, cost and expenses in one place
Sidebar me Reports. Sale, profit, stock,: Reports in the sidebar. Sale, profit, stock, staff and customer reports are there. The item-wise day report is in Day report. Every report can be printed or saved as PDF.
Staff page par naya banda jorein aur \"L: Add the person on the Staff page and create their login with "Give login". Role (manager, cashier) and permissions are set there. Only the owner can do this.
Subah drawer kholein: Open the drawer in the morning
Team member kaise jorein?: How do I add a team member?
